_note: Settings for the form filler. Every key is optional: delete a key to get the built-in behaviour. These settings only decide where files go, what they are called and which template sample text is blanked. They never decide what is typed into a form (that comes from the input sheet). Copy this file and use --settings to keep one per project.

output._note: folders: the folder inside the output folder where each form is written. file_name: used when a Certificates row has no output file name; may use {form} and {id}. spare_rows: for forms with line or joint tables (SL1, MP1, JI1), delete unused blank rows keeping this many spare; leave a form out to keep the template's rows.

header_extra_rows._note: Apache's templates leave one or two blank, unlabelled boxes in the header block. Per form: the labels to write into them, in order, and which project value each takes (field: workpack, sh1, mc1, project_no, site, title). A label is skipped if the form already has one. Use [] to leave a form's blank boxes alone. SH1 and MC1 follow the real packs; NP1, PC1, PP1, SS1 and IRN are not in either pack and are a proposal.
